name: Onsite Optimizer Installer
author: seoplatform

sections.description:
The Onsite Optimizer Installer helps you quickly set up the Onsite Optimizer on your website — no technical knowledge needed.

Once installed, simply enter your Optimizer ID (found in your Platform account) and the plugin will automatically add the Optimizer code to every page on your site.

Key features:
– Simple, non-technical setup
– Automatically adds the Optimizer code to your site
– Works with single and multisite installs
– Prevents duplicate installations

External Services

This plugin connects securely to the Platform’s CDN to enable the Onsite Optimizer.

  • What service is used and why: Loads a script from https://cdn.seoplatform.io/injector.js to activate the Optimizer.
  • What data is sent and when: Only your Optimizer ID (Website ID) is appended as a query parameter (websiteId) when pages are loaded. No other data is shared.
  • Service provider and policies: Service provided by SEO Platform — Terms: https://seoplatform.io/terms — Privacy: https://seoplatform.io/privacy

Uninstall

Deactivating the plugin keeps your settings.
Deleting the plugin removes the saved Optimizer ID for your site.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and upload the ZIP file.
  2. Activate Onsite Optimizer Installer.
  3. Go to Settings → Onsite Optimizer Installer, enter your Optimizer ID, and click Save.

That’s it — the Onsite Optimizer is now active on your site.
